content:
Many people both receive and send messages with large attachments, and the attachments will remain in your SENT and other folders. Although it takes some time and effort on your part, if you comb through your email folders you may find that there's no need to keep some attachments any more. Deleting them can significantly reduce the size of your message store.

If you view your Message List in Table Mode, you can add a Size column. You can then sort the list by size and easily see which messages are using the most room. See my attached image (I see I need to do some housecleaning myself!) After deleting any unneeded attachments, follow up by Compacting the folders.

Another thing that takes up a lot of room is the Global Search database ("global-messages-db.sqlite"). It tends to grow quite large but never shrink. For example, mine is currently 615 MB. The file can be deleted (while Thunderbird is closed) and will be regenerated when the program next runs. It can take up to a few hours to create a new database, and it might or might not be much smaller.

content:
Yes, you can have many accounts with different addresses and servers in Thunderbird.

There are some significant differences in ease-of-use. Opening the second profile would take a few steps. Then switching between profiles would be like switching between apps. If your accounts are in one profile, you must open only one profile and you can switch among accounts with one mouse click.

If you have two profiles, you would have to repeat your customizations, e.g., folder and column layout, installation of add-ons, etc., in each profile.

If you ever want to copy or move messages between accounts, for example if someone writes to you using the wrong address, it is much easier if all the accounts are in one profile.

There would also be differences in ease-of-administation. For example, you would have to back up two profiles.

I would probably think of more differences if I thought longer about it.

Using multiple accounts in one profile is very easy. I don't know a good reason to put accounts in separate profiles.

- Delete all cookies for that account (<Settings | Privacy & Security | Web Content | Show Cookies>);

Now restart Thunderbird. You will be asked for your credentials, and hopefully they will be accepted and mail retrieval will resume.

  1. - install Thunderbird and exit prior to setting up accounts

content:
There's no need to uninstall or reinstall Thunderbird. It wouldn't help in a case like this.

For one thing, Gmail maintains the All Mail "folder," (really a label) which literally includes All Mail, including Deleted, and Spam messages. Even though this shows up as an IMAP folder, it has no purpose in Thunderbird and tends to confuse the user, as you found.

Best practice is to unsubscribe from All Mail. To do that, right-click on the account name in the Accounts/Folders List and choose "Subscribe". You'll see a list of all available folders - uncheck "All Mail", then OK.

Also, check the setting <Account Settings | Server Settings | Server Settings | "When I delete a message"> and confirm that it's set to move to "Trash on Gmail".

From now on, when you delete a message, it will move to Trash like you would expect.

content:
I have no idea what Apple's idea of "migrating" Thunderbird would be - that would be a question to ask of Apple and would be beyond the scope of this forum. My advice may be of limited value, but it should be fairly easy to do manually if you still have access to the data on the old computer. What you will need is the folder called your "Profile", which contains all your email and preferences, and is separate from the program itself.

- On the old computer, start Thunderbird and click on <Help | Troubleshooting Information>. Scroll down to Profile Folder, then click the "Open Folder" button. Close down Thunderbird.

- Go up a level, maybe two, until you're in a folder that contains a file named "PROFILES.INI". Close Thunderbird. Copy this folder to a convenient temporary location on the new computer, using a thumb drive or other method.

- Install Thunderbird on the new computer. Start it up, and if if starts to prompt you to set up an account, decline, and quit Thunderbird.

Copy (not move) the profiles folder from your temporary location to the equivalent location on the new computer, overwriting its contents. If my directions were good and you were able to follow them, when you next start Thunderbird on the new computer, things should work pretty much the way they did before. You might have to re-enter your credentials for some accounts.

When you're satisfied that things are working as expected, you can delete the temporary Profile copy.

Unfortunately, there are many documented ways to transfer a profile, and some are problem-prone. If the transfer was done outside of thunderbird all should be there. Here are suggested steps:

BACKUP

  1. ensure thunderbird is not running
  2. enter %appdata% in search window on task bar and press Enter key
  3. this should open windows file explorer in Appdata\roaming folder
  4. highlight the Thunderbird folder and copy to external media

RESTORE

  1. ensure thunderbird is installed, run once, and NOT running
  2. enter %appdata% in search window on task bar and press Enter key
  3. delete the thunderbird folder
  4. you should be in Appdata\roaming folder , copy&paste the exported Thunderbird folder there.
  5. start thunderbird and all should be there

This process, by using windows file explorer, ensures that every component is transferred. This especially applies to POP accounts, as their files are on the PC and readily copied. 标题：无法发送邮件 本文提供了在无法发送邮件时的故障排除步骤。如果您遇到的是无法接收邮件的问题，请参阅“无法接收邮件”的主页。

该问题是否是在升级到 Thunderbird 某个主要新版本后突然出现的？ 软件阻止发送外发邮件是升级 Thunderbird 后导致无法发送邮件的常见原因。这是因为您的安全软件可能设置了信任旧版本的 Thunderbird，但不再将更新后的版本识别为受信任软件。 请尝试从您的安全程序的可信或公认程序列表中删除 Thunderbird，然后手动重新将其添加回来，或者在系统提示时重新授予权限以解决该问题。

步骤 1：核对您的 SMTP 外发邮件设置 在 Thunderbird 菜单栏中，点击 工具 菜单并选择 账户设置（或者点击应用菜单按钮，选择 选项 / 设置 并进入 账户设置）。 在左侧面板的列表最下方，选择 发件服务器 (SMTP)。 检查您的设置是否与邮件提供商（如 Gmail、Yahoo、Comcast 等）官方文档中说明的设置完全一致。或者，您可以在邮件提供商的网站上搜索“邮件设置”或“SMTP”来查找正确的配置，并确保 Thunderbird 中的设置与其相匹配。

步骤 2：检查是否使用了正确的 SMTP 服务器 进入 账户设置，然后在左侧列表中点击具体的账户名称。 确认该邮箱地址绑定了正确的 SMTP 服务器。在大多数情况下，您不能通过另一个服务商的 SMTP 服务器来发送当前账户的邮件（例如，您无法通过 Yahoo 的 SMTP 服务器发送后缀为 “joe@gmail.com” 的邮件）。

步骤 3：确认外发邮件未被拦截

确认您的外发邮件没有被防火墙、VPN、代理服务器、杀毒软件（有些杀毒软件会启用代理并拦截邮件）或您的互联网服务提供商 (ISP) 拦截：

尝试短暂关闭杀毒软件、VPN、代理和防火墙，发送一封测试邮件；然后重新开启它们，再发送一封测试邮件。

许多 ISP 会封锁 25 端口的外发邮件。您可能需要切换到其他端口（例如 587 或 465）。请联系您的 ISP 客服以确认他们是否封锁了您的外发邮件端口。

步骤 4：确认您的邮件服务器支持最低版本的 TLS 从 78 版本开始，Thunderbird 对 TLS 网络加密协议提出了更高的安全标准。如果您的服务商不支持较新版本的协议，可能会导致邮件发送和接收失败。 您可以临时降低安全标准以检查这是否是导致问题的原因（这明显会降低安全性，因此不推荐长期使用）。

步骤 5：删除或重置 SMTP 密码 删除密码： 尝试删除您保存的 SMTP 密码。但是，请不要将其作为第一步，特别是如果您的密码之前一直正常，只是在更新 Thunderbird 后才无法发送邮件。因为在这种情况下，保存在 Thunderbird 中的密码通常没有问题。

重置密码： 尝试更改您的 SMTP 密码。这通常需要通过您的 ISP（互联网服务商）或邮件服务商网站上的“重置邮件密码”表单来完成。


如果本答案对您有帮助且正确，请按绿色铃铛。✅

content:
Some people confuse threads with conversations and they expect threads simply to group the messages in a conversation. That is not all that threading does.

Threading is a chronological, hierarchical sort order. See my screen image. Message A arrived, then two responses to it. Each response to the responses to Message A also received two responses. Same for Message B. It received two responses. Each of those responses received two responses.

Imagine that all the messages except B1.2 have arrived. Now Message B1.2 comes in, responding to Message B1, which responded to Message B.

The whole point of threading is to present B1.2 at its place in the chronological hierarchy. So it must go into position #11.

It is not possible to show Message B1.2 in its position relative to other messages and put it at the top of the thread. That is what is illogical. This point would be clearer in table view than in cards view, which you are using.

If what you want is just a grouping of messages in a conversation, you may find that Thunderbird's conversations view gives you that. It is being re-developed because, I believe, it is incomplete and buggy, but it may have some value to you anyway. The add-on "Thunderbird Conversations" may also work well for you. I don't know. I have not used it. it seems to be popular.

https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/message-threading-thunderbird

Not a bug, exactly, but a limitation of the Global Search feature (“Gloda”.) Check out this article about it:

https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/global-search

A few of points it mentions...

- Gloda returns searches for each work separately. It disregards punctuation, which is why the dot in your search terms are ignored.

- You can enclose a phrase in quote marks and it will search for it as a phrase. I find that this works, but not consistently.

- It only indexes terms of three or more characters, which is why "bt" is ignored.

You can also use the Search Messages feature, found in the menu item <Edit | Find | Search Messages...> or Ctrl-Shift-F to create more specific and detailed queries. It's pretty accurate. Its limitation is that only works on a single folder (plus subfolders) at a time.

There's also the Quick Filter:

content:
Unified Folders A setting often used by people who have several mail accounts, but like to see an amalgamated list of eg: all emails in Inbox for all accounts in one unified folder.

Only the default folders display as unified folders. Inbox, Drafts, Templates, Sent. Archives, Spam, Trash

The Unified Inbox will have a chevron > to the left indicating it has separate accounts listed. > Inbox If you click on > then it expands to show the various separate mail account inboxes.

Scenario: If a Unified folder eg: Inbox is expanded and only has one account shown, then you may wish to add the Inbox of the other accounts.

  • Right click on Unified Inbox and select 'Properties'
  • Click on 'Choose' button
  • You can then see list of accounts and you need to select the checkboxes for 'Inbox' for all accounts including 'Local Folders'.
  • Click on 'OK'
  • Click on 'Update'

Same process for any Unified Folder - if 'Sent' then make sure you only select the 'Sent' folders of all the accounts.

re :The CFCC shows up in my Unified Folder list but the Gmail does not. Is that normal? Below the list of default Unified folders those you will see the separate names of your accounts. Those accounts display if they contain any folders you created or default folders that have not been selected to be displayed in Unified Folders. Local Folders being the last.

If the gmail account has no folders you created and all it's default folders are selected to display in Unified Folders then it has nothing to display, so will not display.

But you may have a gmail Inbox that has sub folders ? Do you want those subfolders to be displayed under that Inbox section in Unified Folders. If you check the 'Unified Inbox' for 'Properties' and click on 'Choose' - any Inbox subfolder may be selected - if you uncheck those subfolders, then they will be forced to display in a separate gmail account folder.

'All Folders' is the default display option which you have also chosen to be displayed. It shows all accounts one after the other and they all have their own set of folders.

content:
I'm assuming the Pacbell/Yahoo connection is similar to other ISPs such as AOL and Comcast who passed their email service over to Yahoo, although you still use your old email address to logon. Otherwise the account is all Yahoo.

There are a couple of of factors to make Yahoo work with Thunderbird. One is the use of OAuth2 for authentication. Sometimes you have to take some extra steps to force a re-authentication. If that seems to be the case, try these steps:

- Make sure cookies are allowed (<Settings | Privacy & Security | Web Content | Accept cookies from sites>); This may be the real magic bullet in your case and may allow OAuth to show as an authentication option.

- Delete all cookies for that account (<Settings | Privacy & Security | Web Content | Show Cookies>);

- Delete all passwords for that account from saved passwords (<Settings | Privacy & Security | Passwords | Saved Passwords>);

Now restart Thunderbird. You will be asked for your credentials, an OAuth2 token will be set, and hopefully they will be accepted and mail retrieval will resume.

Another thing that may be going on has to do with Yahoo implementing some new security measures. This can affect you if you have multiple Yahoo accounts set up in Thunderbird. If that's the case, you may need to take some extra steps so that Thunderbird is able to keep your accounts separate during authorization. This article describes the situation - the relevant part is the section titled "Configure a Thunderbird preference to make multiple accounts work":

OAuth2 Authentication for Yahoo, AOL and ATT https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/thunderbird-and-yahoo

The bug appears to NOT be fixed in 152.01 .

What I see happening is that when you create a Forward message that has attachments, copies of the original attachment are placed in Windows' %TEMP% folder. When you eventually send the message, those temporary copies of the attachments are attached to the message and they're on their way. And that's what happens if you create the message and send it within a minute or two. However, after some several minutes, the attachment copies disappear from the TEMP folder; if you try to send your message after that time, the attachments can't be found and you get that error message. This is obviously wrong behavior.
